svg.aria-label: Two panels. Data parallelism: three workers each hold all four layers of the model and train on a different batch; what they learn is then combined. Model parallelism: one batch enters worker 1, which holds layers 1 and 2; activations go down to worker 2, which holds layers 3 and 4, and gradients come back up.
svg.text: Each worker trains a full replica on its own batch.
Workers hold different layers; one batch passes through them.
